verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs describe the core of a single pay-run flow. Approved hours flow into payroll and timesheets can be reviewed inside each pay run (rippling-docs-25). The current run can be compared with previous ones before final approval (rippling-docs-1). Permissions span from approving hours to hitting "Run" (rippling-docs-4), and one-off bonuses and custom pay types can be added to earnings (rippling-docs-36, rippling-docs-49). Missing for 10: an explicit description of a totals preview screen, step-by-step documentation of the run/submit flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
